title: Green Account (checking): What happens if a payment exceeds your balance?
summary: Explains what happens with Green Account (checking) when a payment exceeds available funds: at authorization the payment is compared to available balance; if the shortfall is > $5 the transaction is declined and won’t create a negative balance. After a decline, you can retry once you add funds, and you’ll receive a declined-transaction notification per your alert settings (Yes). Tips include checking available balance for the full amount and keeping headroom beyond the amount due to small adjustments interacting with the $5 threshold.
